title: Best Coffee Machines UK
short: Bean-to-cup, pod, espresso and filter coffee machines compared by type, features and who they suit.
intro: The right coffee machine depends on how much fuss you want. This guide compares bean-to-cup, pod, espresso and filter machines picked by Mumsnet's panel and by Expert Reviews' testing, so you can match the machine to your budget and how you drink coffee.

products.name: Magnifica Bean-to-Cup
products.best_for: Everyday espresso-style coffee with little effort
products.summary: The most recommended machine on Mumsnet's forums. It works with beans or pre-ground coffee, has adjustable strength and length, and descales automatically.
products.search: De'Longhi Magnifica bean to cup coffee machine

products.name: The Barista Express
products.summary: A bean-to-cup espresso machine with a built-in grinder, automatic and manual settings and a milk frother. It is a big investment and can be complex for beginners.
products.search: Sage The Barista Express coffee machine

products.name: Classic Pro
products.summary: A professional-looking espresso machine with a crema attachment that works with pods and grounds. It rewards practice but has a steep learning curve.

products.name: One-Touch VCF108
products.best_for: Households where people want either ground coffee or pods
products.key_spec: Ground coffee and pods, automatic milk frother
products.summary: A stylish machine that takes ground coffee or pods, with an automatic milk frother and a fridge-storable milk tank.

products.name: Vivy 2
products.best_for: Costa-style lattes and hot chocolate on a budget
products.summary: A good-value pod machine that makes Costa lattes and Cadbury hot chocolate, is self-cleaning and has an adjustable drip tray. Pod waste is the main drawback.
pros: Costa lattes and Cadbury hot chocolate
products.search: Tassimo by Bosch Vivy 2 pod coffee machine

products.name: A Modo Mio Desea
products.best_for: Milky drinks from a pod machine
products.summary: A pod machine with a built-in milk frother, adjustable froth levels and eight drink options. Mumsnet rates the coffee highly, though pod machines at this level are pricey.
cons: Upper-end pricing for a pod machine
products.search: Lavazza A Modo Mio Desea coffee machine

products.name: Filter Coffee Machine
products.summary: A filter machine that makes 10 large or 15 small cups, with adjustable strength and a reinforced thermal jug that keeps coffee warm for two hours.

specs.Jug: Thermal, keeps coffee warm for two hours

products.search: Melitta filter coffee machine thermal jug

products.name: Coffee Maker
products.best_for: One cup at a time on a small budget
products.summary: A compact manual coffee maker that Mumsnet says makes great coffee and takes up little space. It makes one cup at a time.

products.name: C8
products.best_for: Buyers who put coffee quality above everything else
products.summary: Expert Reviews' premium pick. It produces excellent coffee quality with an easy-to-use automatic milk system, though it is expensive and limited to four drink options.
products.search: Jura C8 bean to cup coffee machine

products.name: Vertuo Pop
products.best_for: Small kitchens and simple pod coffee
products.summary: Expert Reviews' pick for compact spaces. It is small, comes in several colours and offers various drink sizes, though its water tank and mug clearance are limited.

guide.a: Bean-to-cup machines grind fresh beans and give the closest thing to cafe coffee with minimal effort, but cost the most. Pod machines are convenient and simple but create waste and cost more per cup. Filter machines are good for making several cups.

guide.q: Do I need a milk frother?
guide.a: If you mostly drink lattes and cappuccinos, an automatic milk system saves time, but they need regular cleaning. If you drink black coffee, you can skip it.

guide.q: How do I keep a coffee machine in good condition?
guide.a: Descale it regularly as the manufacturer recommends, clean the milk system after use, and empty drip trays and grounds containers often.
